- Section 9 of Executive Order No. 634, dated 03 July 2007, is
hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 9. Term. - The B CARE C shall exercise its powers
and functions until 30 June 2010 unless otherwise directed by the
President of the Philippines."

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONJ3 in the City of Manila, this 21sTday of Janmry , in the year of Our
Lord. Two Thousand and Nine.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
